records.evidence_slice: The Office for National Statistics publishes the Wards (December 2024) Boundaries UK BSC dataset as digital vector ward boundaries for the United Kingdom as at December 2024. BSC is the super-generalised 200m boundary clipped to the coastline (Mean High Water mark). The official dataset exposes ArcGIS FeatureServer, MapServer, GeoJSON, CSV and other download formats. This batch binds the verified Campden ward code E05009390 to that unused December 2024 BSC source window; direct feature extraction and parcel spatial join remain deferred to local OpenCode.
